sections.content: The requirements source defines the toolchain-core-skill-replay-portability-and-evaluation-seed plan and its terminal validation command.
sections.title: Source Overview

sections.content: Acceptance covers byte preservation, repository-owned validator portability, bounded capability resolution, fail-closed detached tests, compatibility replay, evaluation seeds, replay matrices, workflow compatibility, rollback, and non-authorizing evidence.
sections.title: Acceptance Summary

sections.content: All derived artifacts remain non-authorizing. The plan excludes hosted runtimes, live workspaces, browser or API access, account changes, sandbox changes, installed BMAD or GDS writes, autonomous Skill modification, learned ranking, and reinforcement learning.
sections.title: Scope Constraints
